name: Petz Fantasy 3D
description:
Hatch magic eggs into adorable fantasy creatures.

Nurture them and watch their magical powers grow in 3D!

-Care for your Pets and watch how they react to you in 3D!

-Jump from one magical world to another and play fun mini-games to teach them magical powers.
